senses.gloss: SV0141 लंघन laṁghana Therapy which produces lightness of the body is called laṁghana.Reduction therapy consists of two parts Pallative and Purification. Laṁ ghana consist of 10 methods. The first 4 are types of purification process excluding blood letting. Remaining six are palliative therapy viz exposure to wind, exposure to sun, fasting, taking medicine / herbs to increase digestive function etc. This therapy is indicated in preventive and treating Kaphaja and Medo roga.
AF1112 लंघन इच्छा laṁghana icchā Desire to fasting
AT0187 लाङ्गलकी lāṅgalakī Gloriosa superba, a plant having poison in its root/rhizome.
